query: How should we report and interpret local versus global LATEs when IVs affect only firm subpopulations or specific markets?

response.query: How should we report and interpret local versus global LATEs when IVs affect only firm subpopulations or specific markets?
response.answer: Local LATEs apply to specific subpopulations or markets, while global LATEs consider the entire population; compare estimates to understand differential impacts. Interpretation requires assessing context and subgroup relevance. Focus on subgroup-specific effects for local LATEs.

Modification of the Applicable Period for the Hospital Readmissions Reduction Program Measures Set. Identification of Aggregate Payments for Each Condition/Procedure and All Discharges for FY 2027 and Subsequent Years. Adjustment to the LTCH PPS Standard Federal Payment Rate Under the Long-Term Care Hospital Quality Reporting Program (LTCH QRP). We noted that we are not changing the FY 2025 wage index values under section 1886(d)(3)(E) for hospitals eligible for the transitional exception policy on the basis of the exception; the change is applied as a separate step only for purposes of determining the hospitals' FY 2025 IPPS payments. *https://www.federalregister.gov/​documents/​2024/​06/​17/​2024-12842/​medicare-program-medicare-prescription-drug-benefit-program-health-information-technology-standards*.
